I have read the documentation on registering compatibility methods, I have looked at how other PRs handle it and I have asked for help on the developer chat without response. I cannot figure out how I would go about registering compatibility methods if the actual function didn't change and only the PropertyInfo did. Someone smarter might be able to help me out.

> I cannot figure out how I would go about registering compatibility methods if the actual function didn't change and only the PropertyInfo did.

If new `PropertyInfo`s are needed, that means the function signature changes. So this is the regular workflow with compatibility method:
- You register a compatibility method with the _old_ signature (separate file).
- It forwards to the _new_ method in a way that preserves semantic (providing default arguments).
- The _new_ method is now where the old one was, and registered in the normal way, just with additional `PropertyInfo`s.
